action.action-desc: Mr. Vasquez introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs

form.official-title: To direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to seek to enter into a lease for the purpose of establishing a Vet Center in Socorro, New Mexico, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Socorro Vet Center Act.

section.header: To direct Secretary of Veterans Affairs to seek to enter into lease for purpose of establishing Vet Center in Socorro, New Mexico
section.text: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall seek to enter into a lease—

paragraph.text: commencing not later than December 31, 2027; and
for the purpose of establishing a Vet Center (as such term is defined in section 1712A(h) of title 38, United States Code) in Socorro, New Mexico.
